raw_response: {"diagnosis":"raw_transactions contains corrected re-deliveries: 27 txn_ids appear twice in the same batch with record_version 1 and 2, differing only in amount. silver_transactions keeps both copies, so the duplicates inflate counts and totals in every gold table. Keeping the latest record_version per txn_id fixes this.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.85,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) = 1) r WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
